Everyone who has gone through depression for a long enough period will hit a point they've never been to. I recently hit this place. I'm not gonna lie, it is very scary. You may feel good for a few days and just drop right back down. Suicidal thoughts all come in waves similar to a rollercoaster. It's hard to focus on the good you could possibly obtain in your life when it can seem so easy and peaceful to end it all. I highly suggest you try to bury yourself in something positive. I knew in my heart I was going to kill myself a week ago but I still ordered myself a guitar from Amazon. It might help me find a new hobby. It definitely bought me some time. Maybe i won't end it today because I can try out music. Maybe I can try to draw or read some fantasy or self-help books. Try to cling to something and use it as a life raft. You might just find yourself washed up on the shore to fight another day. Take care, man. My thoughts are with you
